prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding injuries sustained in a collision that occurred in a parking lot on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped and waiting for a parked vehicle to clear a space when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The impact was sufficient to deploy airbag components and to damage both vehicles, and the responding officer documented the scene.

Our client immediately experienced neck pain, stiffness, and headaches. Medical evaluation confirmed a whiplash-type cervical strain. Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed medication, and restrictions on lifting and driving that have interfered with our client's work and daily routine. Medical records and billing statements are enclosed, along with a summary of lost wages.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to keep a proper lookout while reversing and is responsible for the harm that followed. We ask that your company review the enclosed materials and respond within thirty days. Our client is prepared to resolve this claim for [DEMAND_AMOUNT], which reflects medical expenses, lost income, and compensation for pain and suffering. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we will file suit without further notice.
